name: Footer Fixed Menu — Customized Bottom Navigation
author: Nitin Monga

sections.description:
Footer Fixed Menu — Customized Bottom Navigation allows you to display a fixed footer navigation bar with icons that automatically sync with your existing WordPress menu.

Perfect for mobile-friendly sites where quick navigation is essential. The plugin creates a sleek, modern bottom navigation bar that stays fixed at the bottom of the screen.

Key Features:

  • Syncs with your selected WordPress menu
  • Customizable background and icon colors
  • Tooltip labels on hover for better user experience
  • Custom pricing/action button with configurable text and URL
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized
  • Easy-to-use admin settings panel
  • Font Awesome icons support
  • No external dependencies – all files included locally

How It Works:

  1. Create or select a WordPress menu
  2. Configure colors and button settings from the admin panel
  3. Add Font Awesome icon classes to menu items
  4. The menu automatically appears as a fixed bottom navigation

Perfect For:

  • Mobile-first websites
  • E-commerce stores
  • Business websites
  • Portfolio sites
  • Any site requiring quick navigation access
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/footer-fixed-menu-customized-bottom-navigation directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance → Menus to create or edit your menu.
  4. Enable “CSS Classes” in Screen Options and add Font Awesome class names to menu items (e.g., fas fa-home).
  5. Go to Settings → Footer Nav Settings to configure colors and button settings.
  6. The menu will automatically appear at the bottom of your site.
sections.faq:
Will it work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin works with any WordPress theme. It uses fixed positioning and high z-index to ensure it appears above other content.

Can I change the colors of the icons and background?

Yes, you can customize background color, icon color, button background color, and button text color from the plugin settings page.

How do I add icons to menu items?

Go to Appearance → Menus, enable “CSS Classes” in Screen Options, and add Font Awesome class names (like fas fa-home) to the CSS Classes field of each menu item.

Can I customize the pricing button?

Yes, you can change both the button text and URL from the plugin settings page. You can make it link to any page or remove it by leaving the URL empty.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices. It’s especially useful for mobile navigation.

Will it slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and only loads the necessary CSS and Font Awesome icons. All files are included locally for better performance.

Can I disable the automatic display?

The plugin automatically displays in the footer, but you can also use the shortcode [footerfixedmenu_nav] to display it in specific locations.
